question: Does the explicit projector construction of COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001D section 3 (eigenprojector leaves made of band-summed copies of a two-arc band loop with bands winding j times around a meridian, balanced band sums for x_u - x_v, disk-framed leaves, Y-graphs with edges routed above the diagram), applied at p = 7, r = 6 to the graph K2 and to the digon, give closed manifolds S^3_6(K_Gamma) with H1 = Z/6 on which the actual lifting obstruction of the free class-2 group has the predicted kernel counts?

public_inputs.group: N = free class-2 group of exponent 7 on e1, e2, e3: A = span(z12, z13, z23), B = span(e1, e2, e3), cocycle beta upper triangular with beta(e1, e2) = z12, beta(e1, e3) = z13, beta(e2, e3) = z23; G = N x| C_6 with the generator acting on e1, e2, e3 by zeta = 3, zeta^2 = 2, zeta^3 = 6 and on z12, z13, z23 by zeta^3, zeta^4, zeta^5 (class (K), p = 7, r = 6)
public_inputs.count: N_psi for the onto meridian character psi (sector psi^1) = #{(c1, c2, c3) in H^1(M; F_zeta) x H^1(M; F_zeta^2) x H^1(M; F_zeta^3) : c1 u c2 = 0, c1 u c3 = 0, c2 u c3 = 0}, the three cup products computed as Heisenberg lifting obstructions (relator z-components evaluated on lifts, reduced modulo the image of the twisted Fox matrix); sector psi^5 likewise with characters zeta^5, zeta^4, zeta^3
public_inputs.base knots: connected sums of braid closures (cp_lib words): K2 base = 3_1 # 3_1 # 6_1 # 5_2 (x_u, x_v, y, t); digon base = 3_1 # 3_1 # 6_1 # 6_1 # 5_2 # 5_2; the twist knots have roots zeta^(+-1) (3_1), zeta^(+-2) (6_1), zeta^3 (5_2) mod 7
public_inputs.arc choice: per summand, the first (gap after crossing k, adjacent positions q, q + 1) inside the summand such that the arc functionals c(a) - c(b) of summands sharing a slot character are independent (pc_fixtures.choose_arcs)
public_inputs.leaves: x-, y-, t-leaves are eigenprojector combs: copies of the band loop around the arcs (a, b), copy j repeated m_j = 6^-1 chi^-j mod 7 times (literal residues 0..6: 21, 28 and 21 copies for chi = 3, 2, 6), the band of copy j winding j times around strand a in direction -1; ell_e = (comb at u) # band above the diagram # (comb at v reversed); y_e, t_e are private combs; all leaves 0-framed (disk framing)
public_inputs.Y-graphs: each Y-graph is surgery on its six-component link: the three leaves and 0-framed Borromean rings at a vertex above-left of the diagram, each ring Hopf-clasped to the root segment of its leaf through an edge routed above everything; the base knot has framing +6
public_inputs.diagram: polygons in R^3, projected after a fixed small rotation; Wirtinger arcs, relators x_j = x_o^-s x_i x_o^s, Seifert longitudes, framing relators mu^f lambda (pc_core.Diagram)

decision_rule: Invalid if a machinery control fails or a built manifold fails H1 = Z/6 or the psi check. Supported if P1-P5 hold and C1, C2, C3 and C5 give their stated values. Refuted otherwise, naming every failed item; a mismatch is diagnosed at this checkpoint and neither the predictions nor the construction are changed.
stop_rule: Run validate.py, then every fixture and control once; no adaptive extension; stop and report to the owner.
environment: workspace .venv python (numpy); cp_lib.py imported read-only from COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001B-P001
red_team_r0: The two fixtures are one realization of the general construction; they test it at p = 7, r = 6 on two small graphs, not uniformly.
The Y-graph surgery is computed as surgery on its six-component link; that model is validated against the braid insertion (V4), not proved here.

At these bases the summands separate the three slot characters, so unprojected leaves would also give 133 in sector psi^1 (C5); the projectors are tested through purity (P3) and the other sector (P5, C3, C5).

Geometry is verified numerically (depth separation at every crossing, no crossings at vertices); the code and the predictions come from the same research program (lane A's tensor and this construction).
The polynomial size bound of the construction is not tested.
nonclaims: No proof of the class-(K) dichotomy; no claim for p = 2, extension fields or other graphs.
No knot-group statement beyond the closed surgeries.
forbidden_inputs: Expected counts as inputs to the construction or to the counting code
